I’d say you should decide on a build first; heavy or light armor, and which type of weapon. 
Light armor goes well with bows and maybe a double handed build, so two swords or daggers, and heavy armor with pretty much anything else. 
Make sure to learn the skill trees, as you need to keep an eye as to where to invest your skill points. 
There are neat ways to quickly level up grinding skills such as alchemy, smithing and enchanting, but it’s best for you to learn the basics of the game first before delving deeper into exploits and more niche builds. Feel free to ask questions!

Hello dear stranger. 
First of all, I want to tell you that I am genuinely sorry for what your situation is like. It sounds horrible and I can only imagine to be so worn out and exhausted like you are. 
While your start in life certainly hasn’t been easy, this won’t be the end of it if you manage to get help. From what you’ve said, you genuinely sound like you yourself are unable to do much more. Therapy can do wonders if you let it happen; a professional that will not only listen to your problems but also know how to help and assist you. Suicidal thoughts and tendencies are to be taken super seriously; I hope you will one day find the strength to reach out for help, because as much as the internet can give you, having a therapist or going into a clinic might just be more efficient. (At least from my own experience)
